name: Pylerium Manager
tagline: Your app studio’s website, store and sales, run from your desktop.
description:
Pylerium Manager builds a beautiful showcase site for your apps, publishes it free on GitHub Pages, and runs the business side for you.

- **Your website**: app cards, pages, screenshots, release notes and videos, in your brand
- **Store**: sell apps with private downloads through Stripe, with new versions reaching past buyers automatically
- **Licence keys**: every buyer gets a signed key; drop-in key checks for Python, JavaScript, C# and C/C++
- **Tax**: Stripe Tax at checkout, sales by country and a heads-up before you need to register
- **Connectors**: post to X, LinkedIn, Mastodon, Telegram and DEV, push builds to itch.io and the Chrome Web Store, with AI-drafted posts from your own Ollama model
- **Autopilot**: Discord alerts, buyer emails, a live dashboard and auto-sync of versions and prices

Every feature is free for 14 days, no card needed. Then A$19.99 a month; cancel any time.
requirements: A free GitHub account. Stripe, Cloudflare, Discord and Gmail are optional.
features: A showcase website for your apps, hosted free on GitHub Pages
Sell apps with private downloads and Stripe checkout
Licence keys with drop-in checks for Python, JavaScript, C# and C/C++
Stripe Tax, sales by country and tax reports
Discord alerts, buyer emails and a live dashboard

Connectors: auto-post releases to X, LinkedIn, Mastodon, Telegram, DEV and Discord with AI drafts from your own Ollama model, show your latest posts on your site, and upload to itch.io and the Chrome Web Store. X supports refresh-token sign-in, link-in-reply, multi-image posts and threads
Promo Studio: promo images for every store and social network, promo videos, and a built-in video editor
A mobile-first site: a live phone menu, an optional bottom bar and a fully customisable donation button

changelog.note: Fixes your website going blank when the phone bottom bar is turned on in Mobile & menu.

Posts that sound like you, not a bot. Everything the AI writer and your automations generate is now cleaned of the usual AI tells before it goes out: em dashes, "Here is your post" openers, "I hope this helps" sign-offs, [link] placeholders, filler intros and stray bold markers, without changing what the post says. Plus Chrome Web Store auto-sync: your extensions are found from your catalog and their live store version, date and status update on your site by themselves.

A mobile-first website and a fully customisable donation button. Your site now has a polished phone menu that lists exactly the sections that are live on the page, with counts, and updates itself as the page changes, plus an optional app-style bottom bar, back-to-top, pinned app search and a compact phone layout, all set from the new Mobile & menu tab. The donation button gets its own text for every spot, a short phone label, six colours, ten icons, a thank-you message and per-placement switches. X posting is fully fleshed out: sign in with a refresh token, automatic daily renewal, link-in-reply, thread numbering and length, multi-image posts with alt text, reply controls, X Communities and post deletion.

Promo Studio and the Edit Studio: promo images for every store and social network made from your apps’ own screenshots (generated automatically as you add them), promo videos with music, and a full video editor for your promos. Plus beautiful customer emails with one-tap copy buttons.

Connectors, polished: a Website feed that puts your latest social posts on your home page with Follow buttons, a new composer with live previews and one-click AI rewrites, an Ollama writer that knows your studio and every app, and smarter automation with per-app filters, per-platform templates and previews. Featured covers are never cropped, and embeds get Product Hunt cards.
New Connectors tab: post to X, LinkedIn, Mastodon, Telegram and DEV, upload to itch.io and the Chrome Web Store, draft posts with your own Ollama model, and automate it all.
Self-hosted app videos, Stripe Managed Payments support, and paid apps no longer show as changed after every publish.
Monthly subscription with a 14-day free trial; enter your key once, renewals are checked automatically.
One Store tab for everything you sell: apps for sale, prices, licences and tax.

name: pagePackage
tagline: Every image, video & file on a page. One gallery. One click.
description: pagePackage is a Chrome extension that finds everything a page contains, shows it in a gallery you can filter and preview, and saves what you pick: one by one, all at once, converted, or as a single ZIP.
features: Finds images, video, audio, documents, fonts, design files, 3D models and streams, including lazy-loaded galleries
Swaps thumbnails for full-size originals on hundreds of sites
Batch download into tidy folders, or save a whole page as one ZIP
Converts WebP, AVIF and SVG to PNG or JPG, video to MP4 and audio to MP3, right in your browser
Views and strips camera, colour profile and GPS metadata before you share
Scans every open tab into one gallery, watches pages for new files and keeps a searchable library

changelog.note: Version 2.7.0 is live on the Chrome Web Store: update from chrome://extensions or wait for Chrome to update it.
Now available on the Chrome Web Store.
Free plan with monthly deep scans, stream captures and conversions. Pro adds unlimited use, site presets, the library and power naming.

name: Pylerium Studio
tagline: A local developer workbench to build, run, inspect and showcase your projects.
description: Pylerium Studio combines Python execution, a Devcord project explorer, opt-in plugins, model tools, a 3D Scene Studio and a video editor in one workspace. Import a folder or ZIP, explore and edit code, run Python scripts, Flask apps or HTML pages with a live preview, and turn your work into showcases and YouTube Shorts.
requirements: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. No Python install needed.
installCommand: Extract the zip, then open the Pylerium folder and run Pylerium.exe
features: Workshop and Devcord: import folders, ZIPs or files, then explore code, dependencies and media
Run Python scripts, packages, Flask apps and standalone HTML pages with a live preview
Scene Studio with music-reactive visuals, particles and recording
Built-in video editor for showcases and YouTube Shorts
Optional phone access over your local network with a QR code

changelog.note: The first full release, free for Windows. One download with no Python install needed: Workshop and Devcord, Python, Flask and HTML runners with live preview, Scene Studio, the video editor for showcases and Shorts, phone preview over your network, and 15 starter plugins plus Jumpback, Ultimate Terminal, Prompt Hub, API Hub and GitHub Engine.
Released free and open source to celebrate 100 YouTube subscribers.

name: HexDrive360
tagline: Inspect and edit live Xbox 360 memory over XBDM, with clear, precise controls.
description: HexDrive360 is a Windows toolkit for connecting to an Xbox 360 development console or RGH console over XBDM and inspecting or editing its live memory. It includes memory scanning, game offsets, XEX inspection and scripting tools. Built for curious modders and preservation-minded users.
features: Connects to an Xbox 360 with XBDM enabled over your network
Memory scanning and byte-level editing of live memory
Game offsets, XEX inspection and scripting tools
Self-contained release: no separate .NET install needed

changelog.note: Licence keys: HexDrive360 now activates with the key from your purchase email (it starts with PYL1-). The key is checked offline and remembered on this PC.

name: pyleriumTV
tagline: Turn the media on your drives into personal TV channels with a live guide.
description: pyleriumTV turns the movies and shows on your attached drives and local storage into personal TV channels, with a live programme guide. Tune in and you join a programme at its wall-clock position, just like real TV.
requirements: Android TV or Google TV, Android 8.0 or newer.
installCommand: Install pyleriumTV-v0.8.0.apk with Downloader on your TV, or: adb install pyleriumTV-v0.8.0.apk
features: Remote-first programme guide with a live time marker, now/next details and progress bars
Channels from whole folders or hand-picked files; USB drives are detected automatically
Plays XviD/AVI, AC3, E-AC3, DTS and 10-bit x265 that Android's own player can't
Encrypted, verified transfers from the paired Pylerium desktop studio

changelog.note: First signed release, free for Android TV and Google TV. Live channels and a programme guide built from the videos on your drives, channel editing from the remote, cable-style surfing and Pylerium Studio pairing. New app icon and TV banner.

name: Pylerium Player
tagline: A polished Android TV app for your own movies and TV shows.
description: Pylerium Player builds a library from your USB drive or local storage, sorts it into movies and TV shows, and plays everything with resume, track selection and automatic next episode, all driven by the TV remote.
requirements: Android TV or Google TV, Android 8.0 or newer.
installCommand: Install PyleriumPlayer-v1.0.0.apk with Downloader on your TV, or: adb install PyleriumPlayer-v1.0.0.apk
features: Automatic library that recognises S01E02, 1x02 and Season folder layouts
Continue Watching, Movies and TV Shows rows with progress and watched badges
Resume, accelerating seek, audio and subtitle tracks, and auto next episode
Hardware decoding where the TV supports it

changelog.note: First signed release, free for Android TV and Google TV. Movies and shows sorted from your file names, continue watching, next episode, and libVLC playback with audio and subtitle tracks. New app icon and TV banner.

name: Pylerium Purge
tagline: A clean, fast, ad-free launcher for Android TV and Google TV.
description: Pylerium Purge replaces the ad-filled stock home screen with a quiet app grid, input shortcuts, Wi-Fi status and a one-row quick launch bar. No ads, no recommendations, no network access.
requirements: Android TV or Google TV, Android 8.0 or newer.
installCommand: Install PyleriumPurge-v1.2.0.apk with Downloader on your TV, or: adb install PyleriumPurge-v1.2.0.apk
features: Remote-first home screen: quick launch row, full app library and TV inputs
Animated boot logo and skeleton loading states
Optional dimmed wallpaper
Set it as your default launcher, and restore the stock one any time

changelog.note: First signed release, free for Android TV and Google TV. An ad-free home screen with a clock, inputs, Wi-Fi status, a quick-launch row and your full app library. New app icon and TV banner.

name: Speak
tagline: Natural, private text-to-speech that runs on your computer.
description: Speak turns text into natural speech locally, with GPU acceleration where available. Nothing is sent to the cloud.

name: Hypnagogia
tagline: Audio-reactive phosphene canvas, binaural synth and dream companion.
description:
A companion platform. You design a living plush companion in the **Atelier**, and every other
feature is a *module* that uses that companion profile: conversation, voice, dreamscapes, and
whatever gets added next. Text-to-speech is one capability, provided by
[speak](https://pylerium.github.io/#app/speak) (Kokoro on MediaPipe, GPU).
```
./start.ps1      # build if needed, start the bridge, open http://localhost:8765
./dev.ps1        # bridge + Vite hot-reload on http://localhost:5173
```

name: PlatypusBrowser
tagline: QA telemetry and environment virtualization suite for deterministic testing.
description: Sandboxed Electron preloads, QEMU MicroVMs, encrypted profile state and proxy routing.

name: MakerPanels+
tagline: Character, car and weapon creators for GTA V, driven from a web panel on your phone or in the browser.
description: MakerPanels+ adds in-game creators for characters, cars, weapons and billboards to GTA V story mode. Each one opens a polished web panel you can use from your PC or phone over your local network, with a live view of the game.
features: Character, car, weapon and billboard creators
Web panels that work on your phone over Wi-Fi
Live game view streamed into the panel
Real in-game textures through TextureForge
